raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"From here, make your way to your final destination.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":2},{"text":"The downtown that began as a 1625 Dutch settlement now holds towers like this.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Look up — when the Woolworth Building opened in 1913, nothing on Earth stood taller.","source_id":"92f6ccee-58cc-431c-8c62-0aff880b3c63","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Cass Gilbert designed it, sixty stories climbing 792 feet, a neo-Gothic tower elegantly dressed in masonry and terra-cotta.","source_id":"92f6ccee-58cc-431c-8c62-0aff880b3c63","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"That reign didn't last, though; in 1930 the Chrysler Building rose higher and surpassed it.","source_id":"92f6ccee-58cc-431c-8c62-0aff880b3c63","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Nearby stands another landmark, the building at 1 Wall Street.","source_id":"8809eaa2-d707-42ff-88b5-dfaa148665ec","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"Today it houses the Bank of New York.","source_id":"8809eaa2-d707-42ff-88b5-dfaa148665ec","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":2},{"text":"That's the walk — the tower that once stood taller than anything on Earth.","source_id":"GLUE_CLOSING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":2}],"threads":[{"from":"Battery Park","text":"From Battery Park's first Dutch fort to a record-breaking tower, the island kept climbing."}]}
